subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: The Deal You Never Agreed To
description: One-minute skill: The Deal You Never Agreed To.

hook.text: You signed up for a social network. You got friends and memes. They got everything about you.

buildup.text: Social media platforms offer free access in exchange for the right to collect, analyze, and sell your data.

discovery.text: The average social media user generates over 1.7 MB of data every second they spend on a platform.

twist.text: You never negotiated this deal. The terms were written by the platform, and the only choice was accept or leave.

climax.text: Social media's bargain is simple: free connection in exchange for total behavioral transparency.

punchline.text: Free platform. Total transparency about you.

quiz.question: What do social media platforms receive in exchange for free access?
options: The right to collect, analyze, and monetize user data
Government subsidies to cover operating costs
Monthly subscription fees from advertisers only
